image_description: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of a pile of assorted bagels. The central focus is on a blueberry or chocolate chip bagel with visible dark inclusions and a golden-brown crust. In the foreground, a plain glazed bagel is out of focus, while other bagels (some with seeds) are visible in the background. The lighting highlights the glossy texture of the crusts.

The object matches the visual definition of a traditional bagel.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant depth-of-field blur is present. This is likely an intentional photographic effect (bokeh) rather than an AI artifact, but it obscures details. No structural melting observed in the transition zones.

The dark spots (blueberries/chocolate) blend slightly into the dough rather than sitting distinctly on top or being fully embedded with clear boundaries. This is a subtle potential fusion issue common in AI food generation.

To distinguish between artistic depth-of-field blur and AI-generated smearing/melting artifacts, especially in the out-of-focus regions.
To verify that the inclusions (dark spots) are topologically distinct entities embedded in the dough and not fused or bleeding into the crust unnaturally.
